fit_card: Scored this Y2K butterfly baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I am obsessed. Can’t wait to throw it on with baggy denim and chunky sneakers for the ultimate nostalgic street fit, or contrast the girly graphic with chunky boots and trousers. It’s officially my new favorite wardrobe staple.

Scored this cropped light wash denim jacket on Poshmark for just $42 and I am already obsessed. I'm leaning all the way into the high-contrast look by pairing it with baggy dark wash jeans and chunky sneakers for the ultimate casual streetwear vibe. Seriously never taking this off!

Scored these chunky platform sneakers on Poshmark for just $48 and I am officially obsessed. I’m already planning all my Y2K off-duty looks with a cropped hoodie and baggy denim. They are about to be my new daily go-to streetwear staple!

Scored this gorgeous butterfly print Y2K baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I’m obsessed. I can't wait to lean into the nostalgic streetwear vibes with baggy denim and chunky sneakers, or mix in some cottagecore sweetness with khaki trousers and combat boots. It’s officially my new favorite piece in the rotation!

scored these low-rise khaki cargo pants on Poshmark for just $27 and I am officially obsessed. I’m living in my Y2K era right now, so pairing them with a black cropped zip hoodie and chunky white sneakers is the ultimate throw-back city fit. Honestly such a win for the wardrobe!

Scored this 2003 tour bootleg graphic tee on Depop for just $24 and I'm totally obsessed. It’s giving the absolute best 90s grunge streetwear energy when I pair it with my baggy dark wash jeans and beat-up combat boots. Can't wait to beat this thing to death this fall!

Scored this black mesh long-sleeve top on Depop for only $15 and I am so obsessed with it. It’s the ultimate grunge layering piece under a white tank, but I'm also ready to lean into full Y2K villain era paired with khaki trousers and chunky sneakers. Honestly the best $15 I've spent all month.

Scored these vintage Levi's 501 jeans on Depop for just $38 and I am never taking them off. They have that perfect broken-in feel for throwing on with a white tank and chunky sneakers for casual streetwear days. Already planning to style them with a cropped hoodie and combat boots when I want an edgy, contrast-heavy look.

Scored this gorgeous chunky brown knit cardigan on Depop for just $35 and I'm honestly never taking it off. It’s giving the ultimate cozy earth-tone cottagecore vibe, whether I'm leaning into effortless neutrals with wide-leg trousers or dressing it down with baggy denim and combat boots. Such a dream find for the cooler weather!

Scored this oversized red and black plaid flannel on thredUp for just $22, and it is officially my new favorite layering piece. I’m already living in it, whether I’m throwing it over a white tank with baggy denim and combat boots for that effortless 90s grunge vibe, or layering a cropped zip hoodie right over it with khaki trousers for streetwear days. Can't beat a good secondhand find that makes outfit repeating this easy!
